## Purpose 
This PR updates to include newer versions of CloudMicrophysics. I don't know what has changed in these releases, but the KinematicDriver downstream test has been failing in Thermodynamics because the package versions can't be resolved (e.g. [here](https://github.com/CliMA/Thermodynamics.jl/actions/runs/23467349179/job/68282320108?pr=314)).

The error from that build:
```
ERROR: Unsatisfiable requirements detected for package Thermodynamics [b60c26fb]:
 Thermodynamics [b60c26fb] log:
 ├─possible versions are: 1.0.1 or uninstalled
 ├─Thermodynamics [b60c26fb] is fixed to version 1.0.1
 └─found to have no compatible versions left with CloudMicrophysics [6a9e3e04]
   └─CloudMicrophysics [6a9e3e04] log:
     ├─possible versions are: 0.1.0-0.32.0 or uninstalled
     └─restricted to versions 0.29 by KinematicDriver [83200819], leaving only versions: 0.29.0-0.29.1
       └─KinematicDriver [83200819] log:
         ├─possible versions are: 0.14.0 or uninstalled
         └─KinematicDriver [83200819] is fixed to version 0.14.0
```
I think expanding the CM compat here may fix it.
title: update CloudMicrophysics compat
